summary: All 9 TDD anchors from tasks/4.md (lines 53-61) map 1:1 to @Test methods with identical names; the 10th matrix case (my_chat_member slot) is covered by an additional test (deserialize_myChatMemberSlot_messageRemainsNull). Every test exercises real Jackson deserialization via plain `new ObjectMapper()` — no Spring context, no mocking, no flakiness. Assertions verify actual record state (field values, nulls, exception classes), not implementation details. Litmus test passes: removing @JsonIgnoreProperties or any record component would cause the corresponding test to fail. Fixtures are realistic Telegram JSON with no real secrets or PII. Naming convention deserialize_<scenario>_<expectedOutcome> is consistent across all 10 tests.

findings.issue: deserialize_malformedJson_throwsJacksonException asserts on parent class JsonProcessingException rather than the more specific JsonParseException. The task hint at line 121 explicitly permits this trade-off (Jackson exception hierarchy churns across versions), so this is intentional and acceptable, but the test loses some specificity — a malformed-JSON regression could now also be masked by an I/O-level Jackson failure of any kind.
findings.recommendation: Optional tightening: assert `isInstanceOf(com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParseException.class)` for parse-level errors; keep JsonProcessingException as a fallback only if a future Jackson upgrade demonstrably breaks the tighter assertion. No action required for this round.

findings.issue: deserialize_channelPostNoFrom_messageFromIsNull verifies channel-post shape via update.channel_post() (the channel_post slot), not via update.message() as the TDD anchor name and tasks/4.md line 41 phrasing might suggest. This is semantically correct (Telegram delivers channel posts in the channel_post field, not message), and the assertion `channel_post().from() == null` directly validates the safe-navigation contract from user-spec AC11a. Worth noting only because the anchor name `channelPostNoFrom_messageFromIsNull` could read as `update.message().from() == null`; the implementation correctly asserts on the channel_post slot.
findings.recommendation: Optional: rename the test to `deserialize_channelPostNoFrom_channelPostFromIsNull` to remove ambiguity, or keep the current name since it aligns with the TDD anchor list in tasks/4.md. No behavioral change needed.
